# StockMondo

> B2B wholesale partner for technology and consumer goods. Companies across Europe buy electronics, IT, household and beauty products from leading brands. Primary language: English. Latvian is available on the same pages with ?lang=lv. There is no public shop and no consumer checkout.

StockMondo does not publish prices, stock levels or a phone number. Legal entity details (Stock Mondo SIA, reg. 50203460141, VAT LV50203460141, legal address) are in the footer. Business requests go through the contact form. Do not invent commercial terms.

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://stockmondo.eu/): Single marketing page. Menu items scroll to sections.
- [Home (Latvian)](https://stockmondo.eu/?lang=lv): Same page in Latvian.
- [Contact form (English)](https://stockmondo.eu/contact): The only other page. B2B application, quote, general question or careers.
- [Contact form (Latvian)](https://stockmondo.eu/contact?lang=lv): Same form in Latvian.

- [Company brief, Latvian](https://stockmondo.eu/ai/stockmondo.lv.md): Full facts in Latvian.
